usage: music-tagger copy [-h] --plan PLAN_FILE [--dry-run] [--log LOG |
                         --no-log]

Copy files to library destinations per a placement plan.

options:
  -h, --help        show this help message and exit
  --plan PLAN_FILE  Plan JSON from `path-for` (possibly LLM-edited).
  --dry-run         Show what would be copied without copying.
  --log LOG         Append changes to this log file (default:
                    $MUSIC_TAGGER_LOG, else ~/Projects/music-
                    tagger/changes.log).
  --no-log          Do not write the change log.
